pay_experience_credit_indistrict_013.evidence: Credit on the salary matrix within job classifications shall be given for all years of qualified in-district experience, and all years of qualified out-of-district experience in a licensed educational role shall be credited.

pay_experience_credit_outofdistrict_014.evidence: Credit on the salary matrix within job classifications shall be given for all years of qualified in-district experience, and all years of qualified out-of-district experience in a licensed educational role shall be credited.

pay_national_board_017.evidence: Educators may claim eligibility for salary increments, National Board Certification, and bilingual and ESL endorsements by submitting a letter on or before September 15 followed by an official transcript as provided below.
